summary.en: Sonoko, Ran, and Conan are going to a "glamping park", a luxury camping, when they witness a murder. Location: Okuhoku Glamping Park Victim: Keidai Tosaki Cause of death: Suffocation from anaphylactic shock Suspects: Kyoko Tosaki, Hiroshi Tanabe, and Mika Miura Tosaki was found dead on the ground with crab sticking out of his mouth, his face covered in marker, a note in his hand, and dressed in women's clothing. It is revealed that all of the suspects moved the corpse to another's room and put thing in the corpse. Now Conan needs to investigate who is lying.
